column1: # The live cells tools/live-report.py publishes, and the corpus each belongs to.
# Live measurement is not a battery that sweeps everything: `speech eval --live`
# runs at the pace of the audio, so one row of twenty minute-long passages takes
# twenty minutes and the whole set takes hours. What exists was measured for a
# reason - a battery for the streaming rows, a chunk sweep for the two families
# with a latency dial - and only the cells measured at a row's SHIPPING setting
# belong in a published figure. A sweep's other tiers describe a setting nobody
# runs; they stay in Private and in docs/live.md, where they are labeled as an
# experiment.
# So the list is explicit rather than a glob over Private: nothing is published
# by accident, and adding a re-run is one line.
#   1 path, relative to the repository; a trailing /* reads every cell in it
#   2 corpus id, or "row.tsv" to take it from the cell's own row
#   3 note for the published page, or empty
Private/live-battery/macos-*/*
Private/live-chunk-sweep-2026-09-17/chunk-11-en_us
